_comment: The floor under octia:sky. Vanilla minecraft:overworld byte for byte, extracted 2026-08-28 from data/minecraft/dimension_type/overworld.json in the 1.21.1 jar per AGENTS.md V, with three keys changed: min_y -64 -> 0, height 384 -> 256, logical_height 384 -> 256. Those three make the WORLD end where the noise band ends. octia:sky's noise settings already declare min_y 0 and height 256, so under minecraft:overworld the rows from -64 to -1 existed and were never generated - open air with no bedrock beneath a sea_level of 96, which is why chunk-probe.py read THE SEA IS DRAINING in 5152 sections of SERENITY_[0_5_6_S_E_A]_project and 4717 of run/saves/[0_6_9]. Water cannot fall out of the bottom of a world; it could only fall out of the part of the world nothing had built. See docs/ISLANDS.md X.
